verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly's experimentation docs say you can build metrics from your own custom events, including numeric metrics. They also say you can run experiments on data from an external warehouse such as Snowflake, which covers both the ingested-events and warehouse paths in the story. Missing for 10: detailed docs on defining metrics directly from warehouse tables (schema mapping, SQL or table selection), only Snowflake named as a supported warehouse, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can define experiment metrics from my own data — warehouse tables or ingested events — instead of a black-box metric store

citations.quote: You can also run experiments using data from an external warehouse, like Snowflake.
You must use custom events to create numeric metrics, which measure and analyze numerical values against a baseline that you set.
You can measure things like page views, clicks, load time, infrastructure costs, and more.
